title: Finite projective-line splitting and diagonal integrals over arbitrary bases
statement:
Let $N\geq1$ be an integer, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] on which $N$ is invertible. Work on small ordinary etale sites with the unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], unbounded derived direct image [def-kun-unbounded-exchange], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For every scheme $T$ over $S$, put $P_T=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};T)=\mathbf P^1_T$ and $r_T:P_T\to T$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Let $A_T$ denote the constant coefficient sheaf. Put $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T$, with roots of unity, scalar action and inverse-image identifications as in [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Let $h_T:A_T\to Rr_{T,*}A_{P_T}(1)[2]$ be the adjoint of the scalar-extended Kummer first Chern class of the hyperplane line bundle $\mathcal O_{P_T}(1)$, obtained by gluing the affine-base constructions [def-pc-projective-space-twist], and the Kummer sequence [lem-amb-kummer-any-base]. Then the map
$$b_T:A_T(1)[2]\oplus A_T\longrightarrow Rr_{T,*}A_{P_T}(1)[2]$$
whose first component is the shifted twisted inverse-image/direct-image unit and whose second component is $h_T$ is an isomorphism. Write $t_T=\operatorname{pr}_2b_T^{-1}$. For every morphism $v:T'\to T$, the canonical proper exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] and the twist pullback identification carry $b_T$ and $t_T$ to $b_{T'}$ and $t_{T'}$.

Put $P=P_S$, $W=P\times_SP$, and let $p_1,p_2:W\to P$ be the two projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. The diagonal $\Delta:P\hookrightarrow W$ is an effective Cartier divisor [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. Let $\delta_A=c_{\Delta,A}:R\Delta_*A_P\to A_W(1)[2]$ be its supported Kummer morphism, with the sign convention $c_{\Delta,A}u_\Delta=c_1(\mathcal O_W(\Delta))$ [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. For $i=1,2$, identify $p_i$ with $r_P:\mathbf P^1_P\to P$, and let $\alpha_i:A_P\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{i*}R\Delta_*A_P$ be the canonical derived-composition identification for $p_i\Delta=1_P$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Then
$$t_P\circ Rp_{i*}(\delta_A)\circ\alpha_i=1_{A_P}\qquad(i=1,2).$$
The base $S$ is not assumed Noetherian or of finite type over a field.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_arbitraryBaseFiniteP1Integrals (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0) :
    ∃ (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
      (d : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
        ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t S hS),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d ∧
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
        finiteP1DiagonalProperty A N hA t d S hS
